complexity: MEDIUM: route behavior is bounded and simple to probe, but a useful playback candidate needs a browser audio experiment, exact CSP/origin behavior, clean failure UX, coordination and actual host evidence.
evidence: Read-only reference inspection found no AGENTS.md in the reference repo file inventory. Model.js documents official relay URLs without ?client=direct and a redirect-following mpv design; Player.qml implements one live audio backend with error reporting and retry behavior.

Primary source: NTS Support, TuneIn article modified 2025-10-15, lists NTS1 https://stream-relay-geo.ntslive.net/stream?client=direct and NTS2 https://stream-relay-geo.ntslive.net/stream2?client=direct as live stream links: https://ntslive.freshdesk.com/support/solutions/articles/77000587257-tunein

On 2026-11-12 from this shell network vantage, a bounded Node fetch used redirect:manual, Range bytes=0-63, 8-second timeout per hop and maximum five hops. All four endpoints (both channels with and without ?client=direct) returned the same shape: relay 302 -> https://streams.radiomast.io/nts1 or /nts2 (302) -> https://audio-edge-kkqan.sin.d.radiomast.io/nts1 or /nts2 (200 audio/mpeg). This is direct HTTP route evidence only, one vantage/time; no bytes were consumed/decoded and it does not prove browser playback.

Local Chromium is installed. A bounded headless audio-element dump-dom experiment did not return output within 30 seconds; no browser media result is claimed. No ChatGPT host/CSP/audible playback result was obtained.

risks: The redirect edge hostname is dynamic by design according to the reference's mpv comments; one observed edge hostname cannot safely be treated as durable.
CSP may reject a redirect destination even when the official relay is admitted; this shell probe does not model MCP Apps CSP or host sandboxing.
Desktop mpv success or raw audio/mpeg HTTP response cannot establish ChatGPT audio-element Play/Pause/resume, audible output, persistence, or coordination.
Broad wildcard Radiomast media permission would expand policy beyond NTS; any necessary broader surface needs an explicit, reviewed NTS-specific route design and clean failure fallback.
